hooks.name: Determinism guard
hooks.description: Blocks ambient randomness and time in code that must be deterministic. See .kiro/steering/determinism.md.

action.command: out=$(grep -rnE 'Math\.random|crypto\.randomUUID|getRandomValues|Date\.now\(|new Date\(' packages/hauntings/src packages/oracles/src packages/replay/src --include='*.ts' 2>/dev/null | grep -v '\.test\.ts'); if [ -n "$out" ]; then printf 'Determinism rule broken. Use the seeded RNG or the injected Clock instead (.kiro/steering/determinism.md):\n%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 1; fi; echo 'Determinism guard: OK'
